response.en: Hello, welcome to Pelangi Capsule Hostel

response.zh: 您好，欢迎来到彩虹胶囊旅舍！

response.en: You're welcome, have a great day
response.ms: Terima kasih, semoga hari anda baik
response.zh: 不客气，祝您愉快！

response.en: We offer cozy capsules, AC, and power outlets. Facilities include hot showers (toiletries provided), a shared kitchen with a water dispenser, free WiFi, and a lounge area. Laundry is available at RM5/load. Let us know if you have more questions!
response.ms: Kami menyediakan kapsul selesa  AC, dan soket pengecas. Kemudahan lain termasuk bilik mandi air panas (sabun disediakan), dapur kongsi, WiFi percuma, dan ruang legar. Dobi layan diri tersedia (RM5). Hubungi kami jika ada sebarang soalan!
response.zh: 我们的设施包括配有空调和插座的舒适胶囊。此外，您可以使用24小时热水淋浴（提供洗浴用品）、共享厨房（含饮水机）、免费WiFi和休息区。洗衣服务每次RM5。如有疑问请随时询问！

response.en: Check-out is at 12:00 PM. Please settle any **bill** at the **front desk** before you leave, and return your key cards. **Payment** options: cash, card, or transfer. Late check-out is free (subject to availability) — let us know in advance.
response.ms: Masa keluar jam 12:00 PM. Sila selesaikan **bil** di **kaunter hadapan** sebelum keluar, dan pulangkan kad kunci. **Pembayaran**: tunai, kad, atau transfer. Late check-out percuma (bergantung ketersediaan) — maklumkan awal.
response.zh: 退房时间为中午12点。请离开前到**前台**结清**账单**并归还钥匙卡。**付款方式**：现金、卡、或转账。延迟退房免费（视房态而定），请提前告知。

response.en: Yes, we offer luggage storage. Space is limited and subject to availability; you can use lockers in the common area (bring your padlock). If you need extra space after check‑out, let us know and we’ll see what’s possible.
response.ms: Ya, kami ada ruang simpanan bagasi. Ruang terhad dan bergantung kepada ketersediaan. Anda boleh guna locker di kawasan umum (bawa padlock anda). Jika perlukan ruang tambahan selepas check‑out, maklumkan kami dan kami akan cuba selesaikan.
response.zh: 我们提供行李寄存。空间有限，视实际可用情况而定。可使用公共区的储物箱（请自备挂锁）。如需在退房后继续寄存，请告知我们，我们将尽力安排。

response.en: Payments can be made via DuitNow QR, Maybank online transfer (551128652007), or cash. Room rates start at RM45/night, RM267 for 7 nights, RM650 for 30 nights. A RM10 card deposit (refundable) is required for stays >7 nights, and a RM100 security deposit for long‑term bookings.
response.ms: Pembayaran boleh dibuat melalui DuitNow QR, pemindahan Maybank (551128652007), atau tunai. Caj per malam bermula RM45, RM267/7 malam, RM650/30 hari. Deposit kad RM10 (terpulang) diperlukan bagi tempahan >7 malam, dan deposit keselamatan RM100 bagi tempahan jangka panjang.
response.zh: 付款可使用 DuitNow QR、马来银行转账（账号 551128652007）或现金。房价从 RM45/晚起，7晚 RM267，30晚 RM650。入住超过7晚需缴纳 RM10 可退还的卡押金，长期住宿需缴纳 RM100 安全押金。

response.en: Our hostel follows a few simple rules for a comfortable stay: Quiet hours 11 PM–9 AM, no smoking indoors, no outside guests, **pets are not allowed**, keep shared spaces tidy, and report any damage immediately. Let us know if you need any clarifications!
response.ms: Kami mempunyai beberapa peraturan mudah: Waktu tenang 11 PM–9 AM, tidak merokok dalam bangunan, tiada tetamu luar, **haiwan peliharaan tidak dibenarkan**, bersihkan ruang bersama, laporkan kerosakan segera. Sila maklumkan jika ada soalan!
response.zh: 宿舍遵守简易规则：安静时段 11 PM–9 AM，室内禁烟，禁止外部访客，**不允许宠物**，保持公共区域整洁，损坏请及时报告。如有疑问请告知！

response.en: Of course! Our housekeeping team will deliver extra towels, pillows, or blankets to your capsule. Contact our on-site staff Maya via WhatsApp at +60127088789 and let her know what you need!
response.ms: Tentu! Pasukan housekeeping kami akan hantar tuala, bantal, atau selimut tambahan ke kapsul anda. Hubungi staf kami Maya melalui WhatsApp di +60127088789 dan beritahu dia apa yang anda perlukan!
response.zh: 当然可以！我们的客房服务团队会将额外的毛巾、枕头或毯子送到您的胶囊房。通过WhatsApp联系工作人员Maya（+60127088789），告诉她您需要什么！

response.en: The **bathroom** and **shower** are at the **back** of our capsule area. **Toilets** and hot water are in that shared space — follow the corridor past the capsules. The **location** is clearly marked!
response.ms: **Bilik air** dan **pancuran mandi** berada di **belakang** kawasan kapsul kami. **Tandas** dan pancuran air panas ada di ruang kongsi itu — ikut koridor melepasi kapsul. **Lokasi** jelas ditandakan!

response.en: I'm sorry to hear that. We will **review** your bill and **investigate** — if there was an overcharge we'll discuss a **refund**. Our staff will contact you shortly. — Rainbow 🌈
response.ms: Maaf mendengar itu. Kami akan **semak** bil anda dan **siasat** — jika ada lebihan caj kami akan bincang **refund**. Staf kami akan hubungi anda tidak lama lagi. — Rainbow 🌈

response.en:
🛏️ *Capsule Deck Info*

Our capsule numbering works like this:
• **Even numbers** (C2, C4, C6, C12, C14...) = **Lower deck (bottom bunk)**
• **Odd numbers** (C1, C3, C5, C11, C13...) = **Upper deck (top bunk)**

For example: C5 is *upper deck* (top bunk), C4 is *lower deck* (bottom bunk).

Most guests prefer lower deck — we try to assign even-numbered capsules first! If you'd like a specific deck, just let us know. 😊

— Rainbow 🌈
response.ms:
🛏️ *Info Dek Kapsul*

Sistem nombor kapsul kami:
• **Nombor genap** (C2, C4, C6, C12, C14...) = **Dek bawah**
• **Nombor ganjil** (C1, C3, C5, C11, C13...) = **Dek atas**

Contoh: C5 ialah *dek atas*, C4 ialah *dek bawah*.

Kebanyakan tetamu prefer dek bawah — kami cuba assign nombor genap dahulu! Jika anda nak dek tertentu, beritahu kami. 😊

— Rainbow 🌈
response.zh:
🛏️ *胶囊房层信息*

我们的胶囊编号规则：
• **偶数** (C2, C4, C6, C12, C14...) = **下层（下铺）**
• **奇数** (C1, C3, C5, C11, C13...) = **上层（上铺）**

例如：C5是*上层*，C4是*下层*。

大多数客人更喜欢下层——我们会优先分配偶数胶囊房！如果您有偏好，请告诉我们。😊

— Rainbow 🌈

response.en:
♿ *Accessibility Info*

Thank you for asking! We want to be transparent about our accessibility:

• Our hostel is a *2-storey shophouse* with stairs to the upper floor
• Capsule beds require *climbing in/out* (upper deck has a ladder)
• Bathrooms have *standard fixtures* (no grab bars)
• Corridors are *narrow* between capsule rows

We understand this may not be ideal for wheelchair users. However, our staff are always happy to help accommodate special needs as best we can. Please contact Maya at +60127088789 to discuss your specific requirements — we'll do our best to help! — Rainbow 🌈
response.ms:
♿ *Info Aksesibiliti*

Terima kasih kerana bertanya! Kami ingin jujur tentang aksesibiliti kami:

• Hostel kami adalah *rumah kedai 2 tingkat* dengan tangga ke tingkat atas
• Katil kapsul memerlukan *memanjat masuk/keluar*
• Bilik air mempunyai *kemudahan standard* (tiada palang pegangan)
• Koridor *sempit* antara barisan kapsul

Kami faham ini mungkin kurang sesuai untuk pengguna kerusi roda. Namun, staf kami sentiasa gembira membantu keperluan khas. Hubungi Maya di +60127088789 untuk bincang keperluan anda — kami akan cuba sedaya upaya! — Rainbow 🌈
response.zh:
